name: Colostrum Plus
headline: Colostrum Plus
description: A synergistic complex of bovine colostrum and beta-glucans for immune support. It helps strengthen immunity, raise the body's resistance to pathogens, speed up regeneration and protect and restore the lining of the digestive tract.
howToUse: Adults – 2 capsules twice a day with food.

manufacturing.expiration: 2 years from the date of manufacture
manufacturing.storage: Store in a dry place, protected from direct sunlight, out of reach of children, at a temperature not above +25°C.
manufacturing.ingredients: Bovine colostrum 250 mg, beta-glucans (beta-1,3/1,6-glucans) 50 mg, excipients.
